caption: The drawing depicts the facade of a mission-style building rendered in black and white. The structure features three prominent archways at the base, topped by a horizontal section with brick or stone patterning on the lower and upper portions. Above the main section, the central area rises in a stepped, curvilinear gable, which contains a single arched window flanked by two pilasters and capped by a rectangular element. To the left, a smaller vertical section includes another arched window with a capped top. The composition is centered on a mostly white background, and beneath the building facade, there is a ribbon banner with the hand-written text "171/ mission san antonio de padua."
title: Mision San Antonio de Padua
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
